finding.title: Valid task/run grant invalidates host executor during subsequent reconciliation
finding.trigger: A successful BeginRuntimeQualification creates a Run and appends its exact executor/project/task/run grant. Next uncached RuntimeSetup.Reconcile revalidates the executor.
source_chain: host/runtime_setup_windows.go:117 success cache expires after 5 minutes
runtime_routes_windows.go:28 omits route with setup failure
finding.impact: Executor now has the original project grant plus a valid narrow run grant; exact-count validation returns FORBIDDEN. Reconciliation suppresses the prepared route and blocks future normal route use. Existing Run/effect/UNKNOWN history is not erased by this path.
finding.phase1_effect: No invalidation of the narrowly scoped offline preparation evidence, which retained zero Runs. This defect prohibits treating that acceptance as operational qualification or publish readiness.
finding.suggestion: In a new frozen candidate, validate the original project grant plus each permitted narrowly scoped executor grant against the actual project/task/run/executor ownership. Continue rejecting unexpected roles, foreign projects, unrestricted extra authority, invalid lineage and revoked identities. Add bounded fixture coverage of BeginRuntimeQualification followed by forced/uncached reconciliation and rejection controls.
finding.verification_level: INDEPENDENT_STATIC_CALL_CHAIN; no phase2 execution or 5-minute wall-clock reproduction claimed
